test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can do a certain piece of work in 8 days, B can do the same work in 18 days and C can do the same work in 12 days. Find the number of days it will take to complete the same work, if they all work together.
solution:
**Given:**

A's rate: 1/8 work/day

B's rate: 1/18 work/day

C's rate: 1/12 work/day

**Formula:**

Total work done together = Sum of individual rates

⇒ Total rate together = 1/8 + 1/18 + 1/12

LCM of 8, 18, 12 = 72

⇒ Total rate = (9/72) + (4/72) + (6/72)

⇒ Total rate = 19/72 work/day

Time taken together = 1/Total rate

⇒ 1/(19/72)

⇒ 72/19 days

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
